purpose: Legacy single-crop domain diagnostic; not whole-hand accuracy or detection mAP

method.resize: Pillow bilinear RGB letterbox; 114 padding; CHW float32 /255
method.resize_caveat: Pillow and Dart image bilinear implementations may differ slightly.

limitations: No capture-session or physical tile-set identity is present; leakage-safe splits cannot be established.
No real multi-tile bounding-box annotations are present.
Byte-deduplication does not detect near-duplicate source crops.
